question: When the s019 LS-bracket strategies are re-scored against the s042 basin rule (not a flat 5% bar), what fraction of the cohort is actually covered, and how does it stratify by |omega|?
hypothesis: The 98/100-within-5% headline overstates usable coverage; under realistic basin widths the bracket covers far fewer seeds and breaks down on the fast |omega| tail.
narrative_md: Re-scored s019's per-seed bracket offsets against the s042 basin rule: the 98/100-within-5% headline drops to 54/100 (conservative) to 75/100 (lenient) basin coverage, strongly |omega|-stratified (Q1 24/25 vs Q4 5/25). The bracket offset is roughly constant ~1.25% while the basin shrinks ~3x toward the fast tail. Conclusion: s019 bracket is a good coarse prior but needs local densification on fast seeds. Compares offsets against truth |omega|.
